name: archicad-agent-bridge
description: VS Code chat participant and agent tool for driving Archicad through AgentBridge.

languageModelTools.name: archicad_create_house_plan
languageModelTools.userDescription: Creates a parametric starter house plan in the active Archicad file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool when the user asks to create a house, floor plan, residential layout, or multi-storey starter BIM model in Archicad. It sends dimensions and floor count to the local AgentBridge Archicad add-on. Do not use it for code-only tasks or when Archicad is not running.

width.description: Overall building width in meters. Defaults to 12.

depth.description: Overall building depth in meters. Defaults to 9.

storyHeight.description: Floor-to-floor height in meters. Defaults to 3.

commands.title: Archicad Agent Bridge: Create House Plan From Prompt

archicadAgent.portStart.description: First Archicad JSON Interface port to probe.

archicadAgent.portEnd.description: Last Archicad JSON Interface port to probe.
